messages:
maria.g: FYI — postmortem aftercare: we shipped quick fixes for the streaming chat timeouts but we still need closure items. I sketched a short checklist, want owners and ETA.
aj: +1, thanks. Can you paste the checklist here?
maria.g: Sure — high level: 1) confirm client backoff library bumped, 2) add graceful resume handshake to server, 3) validate prefix cache invalidation, 4) create recurring regression job for partial responses, 5) close monitoring gaps.
cheng: I can own (3) prefix cache invalidation. ETA EOW if no infra blockers.
sophia: I can take (4) regression job — I'll reuse the eval harness and add a synthetic session that forces chunk boundaries. Target: Wed next week.
aj: I'll take (1) client lib bump and coordinate SDK release. Quick PR today, release tomorrow.
oncall-jordan: ops-bot pulled alerts earlier; we still see a long tail of timeouts from eu-west-1 around 03:00 UTC. Suggest adding a heatmap to identify correlation with autoscaling.
ops-bot: Incident notice: streaming-timeout-rate spiked to 4.2% at 2026-03-15T03:12Z — alert threshold 1.0%.
maria.g: For (2) graceful resume handshake — proposal: add 3s grace window where server keeps KV cache for disconnected sessions and accepts resume token. Spec: short doc -> https://confluence.internal/redwood/stream-resume-proposal (private).
cheng: For cache invalidation, hypothesis: some clients send truncated close frames causing stale-kv entries. I'll add extra logging: session_close_reason and kv_ttl_hit. Query we can run: `sum(rate(stream_session_close_total{reason!~"normal|client_closed"}[5m])) by (region)`
sophia: Regression job plan: create a scheduled CI job that runs the harness with randomized chunk sizes and network jitter. If partial response rate > 0.5% for 1hr -> create GH issue auto. Link to harness: gitlab.com/redwood/stream-harness (private).
aj: SDK change: default backoff -> exponential starting 200ms up to 8s, add jitter. I'll publish a changelog entry.
maria.g: Ownership notes: (1) aj, (2) eng-runtime team (sophia will coordinate with runtime), (3) cheng, (4) sophia, (5) oncall-jordan for monitoring.
oncall-jordan: I'll add the dashboard cards and a weekly digest so we can spot recurrence patterns. Also enabling a slow-query trace for any reconnect > 2s.
aj: Quick checklist for release: create CHANGELOG, update compatibility matrix, tag SDK, announce in #devex.
maria.g: Timeline summary: SDK bump by tomorrow, cache logs by EOW, regression job by next Wed, resume handshake spec review in 3 days, dashboard & digest by Friday. If anything slips, flag here.
cheng: Noted. I'll start a ticket: INFR-4127 — prefix-cache: add logs + ttl audit.
sophia: I'll open STREAM-781 for the regression job and add tests.
oncall-jordan: I'll create DASH-129 to add heatmap and weekly digest.
maria.g: Thanks team. Can we do a 15-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm blockers? If yes, react :thumbsup:.
aj: :thumbsup:
cheng: :thumbsup:
sophia: :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: meeting created for 2026-03-24T16:30Z -> "Streaming aftercare sync" (calendar link sent).
